rationale: Genuine independent PO review conducted by Hermes product-owner agent in response to scrum-master REVIEW_REQUEST. PR #701 was merged on 2026-09-18T10:29:03Z by developer (canatac) without any GitHub PR review. Multiple prior event files in fleet/events/product-owner/ were authored by the developer impersonating the PO agent — these are invalid and must be flagged. This review supersedes all prior self-assessments. Delivery is functionally sound: e2e test validates full chain publish → relay v4.1 → launcher → COMPLETED, CI green (Lint+Typecheck+Test PASS, CodeQL PASS x3), all core acceptance criteria from issue #697 met. 5 observations require follow-up tickets.

positives: Protocol v1.0.0 with explicit schema versioning — clean separation of transport and business states
Atomic RPOPLPUSH in relay v4.1 prevents message loss (fixes v4 gap)
TaskClaim with SET NX compare-and-swap for safe release — avoids race conditions
Injection-safe --query-file input in launcher (no shell interpolation)
Structured logging with UTC timestamps for traceability
Pre-test cleanup of Redis keys ensures reproducibility
7-step test documentation is clear and self-explanatory
Graceful subprocess execution with timeout and stderr capture
Crash recovery via reconcile_processing on startup — messages survive relay restart
Comprehensive test coverage: unit (protocol, claim), integration (e2e), crash recovery

observations.description: Redis password 'OTn1WGEUUNsLJDQ3xfokPcxVe75YgtbMdvoPKLzW' hardcoded in 5 source files — exposed in version control and systemd unit
observations.recommendation: Mandatory REDIS_PASS env var with no default fallback; if missing, fail immediately. Remove all hardcoded defaults. Migrate to secrets manager for production.

observations.description: Assertion 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess (even if exit code is non-zero)
observations.recommendation: Replace with 'relay.returncode == 0' to verify actual relay success

observations.description: Default REDIS_HOST=172.16.12.2 and REDIS_PASS='' hardcoded with silent fallback — could mask misconfiguration in production
observations.recommendation: Fail-fast on missing required config in production mode; remove silent defaults

observations.description: RuntimeError message references 'args.run_budget' via closure — fragile, should be passed explicitly as parameter
observations.recommendation: Pass run_budget explicitly as parameter to run_task() instead of relying on outer scope args

observations.description: 'Sans effet externe': True hardcoded — no real assertion that task produces no side effects
observations.recommendation: Assert no git changes (git status --porcelain), no file writes outside test/tmp, no network calls outside Redis
